cards.title: Release 0.21.0: merge, tag, push
cards.summary: The migration release: initiatives **i13** (EARS lines), **i11** (final layout), **i10** (work-items and `work run`), **i8** (`migrate run` for consumers) and **i15** (300-line size check) are done, and the final review's fix wave (2 Critical, 24 Important) is merged. Suite **572 passed** in ~7 s; `model check`'s 141 violations are **121 v_s3** (workflow lines whose fixture scenarios wait for formulation-1) and **20 v_w4** (6 green worker items, 14 withdrawn items). **Approve** = merge to main, tag `v0.21.0`, push.
cards.body:
deliver-real (delivery-5): v1-v3 green 3 of 3, plus x1 (session drafts) green; 5/5 checks each; 174-200 s and $0.65-0.75 a delivery
i8 through `work run`: run 1 stopped at research ($0.09; defect fixed 015eb88); run 2 all four stages, 25 min 40 s, $3.25 of workers; run 7 (migrate-kb-2) green first pass, 9 min 01 s, $1.54
kb migration trials: trial 1 refused (123 unnumbered entries, nothing changed); trials 2 and 3 exit 0 in ~1.4 s, kb suite 1603 passed unchanged, one file problem (README id), fixed after (238237a)
T-integrate (decision files taught) 3 of 3; T-formulate (formulation deprecates) 3 of 3
Suite ~120 s -> ~6 s (pytest-xdist, bindings walk fixed)

cards.title: Workers can run any Python through pytest
cards.summary: Every stage may run `python3 -m pytest` and write files (acceptEdits), so a worker can run any Python through a conftest or probe file; r14's limit holds for commands, not for what tests run (final review S1). The fix wave closed the direct path: workers now get only `features`, `model` and `tools` by path, never `work` or `migrate`. **Recommend A**: accept it inside the worker's own worktree, guarded by the two lines below. B: an OS sandbox around workers, in a later release.
cards.body:
supervision r21: **If** `work run` is started by a worker of another `work run`, then `work run` shall refuse, saying so. (unbuilt)
supervision r28: **If** the main checkout's `.shop/work/` differs from its last commit when a worker ends, then `work run` shall put it back and move the work-item to `awaiting-ruling`, naming each file. (unbuilt)

cards.title: May .shop/delivery.toml widen a stage's tools?
cards.summary: Today `[allowed_tools]` replaces a stage's list and drops only bare `Write` and `Edit`, so `Bash`, `Bash(*)` or `Write(**)` pass (S6); neither it nor `[tests]` has a line. **Recommend A**: it is the person's own file, an override, as ruled at skeleton-evidence (ledger 120) and as the README now says. B: refuse any entry outside r14's set. r29 (`[tests]`) goes in either way.
cards.body:
A, supervision r30: **Where** `.shop/delivery.toml` gives a stage's `[allowed_tools]`, `work run` shall give that stage's worker that list in place of its own, less any bare Write or Edit. (built)
B, supervision r30: **If** `.shop/delivery.toml`'s `[allowed_tools]` gives a stage an entry outside r14's set, then `work run` shall refuse, naming the entry. (unbuilt)
both, supervision r29: **Where** `.shop/delivery.toml` gives `[tests]`, `work run` shall run those commands in place of its own tests. (built)

cards.title: role-boundaries r4 vs the implementer's Skill tool
cards.summary: r4 says the implementer has no Skill tool, but it has had one since 3ab836c: a `claude -p --agent` session does not preload `skills:`, and the first real implementer stopped `NEEDS_CONTEXT` without it (deliver-real). supervision r12 already allows each listed skill, so the spec contradicts itself. **Recommend A**: change r4; `test_agents.py`'s expected failure then becomes a check. B: keep r4, drop the Skill tool and find another way to load `bdd-red-green`.
cards.body: A, role-boundaries r4 (change): The plugin's agent definitions shall give the implementer the skills listed under its `skills:`, `bdd-red-green` always among them, and the Skill tool, which `work run` allows only for those skills. (built)

cards.title: Who writes the file set r20 runs on?
cards.summary: r20 (two ready items with disjoint file sets at once) never fires in a real run: nothing writes `fileset:` into a work-item, and its scenarios pass only because their Given writes it (S4). Both the researcher's and the planner's results carry a `fileset`. **Recommend A**: the planner's final set, written as the item moves to `planned`, since that is the set the implementer works to. B: the researcher's, at `researched`. C: move r20 to Not yet.
cards.body:
A, supervision r31: **When** a planner's result gives `DONE` with a `fileset`, `work run` shall write that file set into the work-item as `fileset:` as it moves it to `planned`. (unbuilt)
B, supervision r31: **When** a researcher's result gives `DONE` with a `fileset`, `work run` shall write that file set into the work-item as `fileset:` as it moves it to `researched`. (unbuilt)

cards.title: Other proposed lines
cards.summary: Each line below passed `model check` with no v_e1 or v_e2 row, in a scratch copy of its capability file. Ids are above the highest ever used, or name the line they change. **Approve all, or name the exceptions.** Lines marked unbuilt each get a work-item after the release.
cards.body:
supervision r14 (change): `work run` shall allow a worker's Bash only `python3 -m pytest`, the plugin's scripts its stage runs, by path, and the git commands its stage needs. Evidence: workers now get only `features`, `model` and `tools`, so a nested `work run` by path is refused (S1). (built)
supervision r22: `work run` shall give every pytest run it starts, and every worker's, the plugin's option `--work-item <name>`, which selects the scenarios the work-item accepts. Evidence: without it every merge in a consuming repository failed "unrecognized arguments"; now shipped as scripts/work_items.py (R1, ledger 114). (built)
supervision r23: **Where** the repository is inside the plugin's own directory, `work run` shall make each worker's worktree in a temporary directory outside it. Evidence: i8 run 1's writes were refused under `--plugin-dir`; fixed 015eb88 with scenario 8f5d556. (built)
supervision r24: **When** `work run` starts an implementer, `work run` shall first run the whole suite in the implementer's worktree and put its result in the brief. Evidence: i8 run 2 logged "Suite: 547 passed, 0 failed at 2a56b96" before the implementer; no line states it (M17). (built)
supervision r25: **When** `work run` writes a worker's brief, `work run` shall name in it the plugin's scripts directory, the initiative's base commit, the worker's worktree and its branch. Evidence: supervise_brief.py writes Scripts:, Base:, Worktree: and Branch:, ruled at ledger 110; no line states it (M17). (built)
supervision r26: **When** `work run` moves a work-item to `awaiting-ruling`, `work run` shall keep the work-item's branch. Evidence: the branch's fate was left to evidence (ledger 103), and the runs since kept it for the re-run (M17). (built)
supervision r27: **When** every work-item of the initiative is `green` or `withdrawn`, `work run` shall start a `claude -p` session of `bdd-branch-reviewer` over the initiative branch from its base, given one brief file. Evidence: bdd-branch-reviewer is rewritten for initiatives (I10) but no stage starts it, so decision 0040's branch review never runs. (unbuilt)
role-boundaries r5 (change): The plugin's agent definitions shall name each agent's model: Opus for the spec writers, the planner and the reviewers, Sonnet for the implementer, `initiative-round` and the `spec-checker`, Haiku for the scout. Evidence: spec-checker.md uses sonnet and r5 does not place it (M24). (built)
red-green r17 (change): **When** the work needs a file outside the work-item's file set, the implementer shall name the file in its report under `## Outside the file set` before editing it. Evidence: `work claim` does not exist, and bdd-implementer.md already does this (I9). (built)
red-green r37 (retired, to Not yet with `work claim`): a refused claim cannot happen while there is no `work claim` (I9).
design-model-check r27 (row, change): ... or a work-item that is not `withdrawn` accepts a requirement no scenario names yet. Evidence: most of the 168 file problems are withdrawn items, which r36 already counts as closed (M-model-1). (unbuilt)
design-model-check r106 (new row under the "If `model check` finds a case of a row below" line): v_w4 | a work-item that is not `withdrawn` has no `accepts` and no `check`. Evidence: 14 of the 20 v_w4 rows are withdrawn items, and no line states v_w4 today (model.lp:232). (unbuilt)
design-model-check r19 (change): `model` shall read, under `--root` (default the current directory), only `spec/index.md`, `spec/capabilities/*.md`, every `*.feature` under `features/`, every `spec/decisions/*.md` but `index.md` and `README.md`, `.shop/work/<initiative>/*.md`, `.shop/records/observations.md` and any other Markdown under `.shop/records/` whose frontmatter has an `id`. Evidence: migrate leaves a README at spec/decisions/README.md, which model reports as a decision with no id and no ## Decision (I4). (unbuilt)
analysis-tools r17 (change): **If** a tool that `tools check`, `tools tests-of`, `tools untested` or `tools refs` needs is missing, then `tools` shall name it as missing rather than skip it, and exit 1. Evidence: `tools check` exits 0 with every tool missing (M10). (unbuilt)
feature-file-tools r35 (change): **If** the title given to `features tag`, `move`, `deprecate` or `retire` is in no file, is in several without `--file`, is not exactly once in the file `--file` names, or `--file` or `--to` names a file outside `--dir`, then `features` shall refuse, naming each file that has the title, and change no file. Evidence: `features move --to` writes outside `--dir` (M11). (unbuilt)
migration-tools r3 (change): **When** `migrate run` finds a `@holding` scenario, `migrate` shall tag it `@deprecated` with " (deprecated)" for " (held)" on its title and `Deprecated for:` for `Held for:`, rebind each test that names it by title, and leave no `@holding` tag. Evidence: today it gives "held one (held) (deprecated)", keeps `Held for:`, and the test loses its binding; the skill does this by hand meanwhile (I5). (unbuilt in migrate)
spec-migration r15 (change): **When** a repository is migrated, `migrating-to-capabilities` shall leave it on the final layout: decisions one file each in `spec/decisions/` with the generated `index.md`, work and records under `.shop/`, nothing of the plugin under `docs/superpowers/` or `.superpowers/`, and `model check` reporting no file problem that names `scripts/migrate`. Evidence: `migrate status` does not exist (migration-tools Not yet), and the rewritten skill checks with `model check` (I2). (built)

cards.title: Decisions proposed in this release
cards.summary: Fifteen decisions are still `proposed` (0051 and 0052 are already accepted). **Accept all, or name the exceptions.** Notes after a summary say what changed since the final review.
cards.body:
0037 a script supervises delivery: `work run` pulls work-items through their stages with fresh `claude -p` workers, and is the only status writer.
0038 worker results are files: one brief in, one JSON result out; no prose parsed, no resume.
0039 the work-item lifecycle as run: drafted, researched, planned, ready, claimed, done, green, plus awaiting-ruling; amend it to add drafted->awaiting-ruling and done->awaiting-ruling, which `work run` makes (M19). Claimed->awaiting-ruling on failure is now built (S5).
0040 review of work-items: a risk-named item gets a task review and every other gets the branch review; findings become fix items or observations. The branch review is unbuilt (supervision r27).
0041 the file set is the claim: disjoint sets run at once, each in its own worktree. Who writes the set is the r20 card.
0042 superpowers is not a dependency: now true; plugin.json is 0.21.0 with no dependency, and slicing and `scripts/plan` are removed.
0043 fixture scenarios under pytest-bdd: tagged `@fixture` and deselected; pytest.ini now has `-m "not fixture"`.
0044 plans list the tests they break: with two allowances measured from the initiative's base.
0045 the final layout: spec/, features/, .shop/ with .shop/scratch/; model reads only that.
0046 light decisions: frontmatter plus a Decision section; Context and Alternatives only where options were weighed.
0047 references are ids: no paths in frontmatter, no `formulated_as`, sources as ids with free text in `by:`. kb trial 2's README row rests on it.
0048 plugin scenarios run as pytest-bdd: one `scenarios()` per feature, and `--unbound` fails the suite.
0049 migration in one pass: `scripts/migrate` makes every mechanical change behind one gate; the skill now runs it.
0050 a living plan becomes work-items and observations: unbuilt (`migrate plan` is Not yet; the skill does it by hand).
0053 the v3 agents: exact tools and a pinned model each, bdd-planner added, only initiative-round can start an agent; tests/scripts/test_agents.py now checks it; its "no Skill" cell follows the r4 card.

cards.title: Readings to confirm
cards.summary: These are the coordinator's readings and rulings, made while you were away. **Confirm all, or name the exceptions.**
cards.body:
migrate's formulation readings (ledger 115): it reads both the decisions directory and the ledger; records keep their paths; superpowers plans and specs go to the archive; a ledger entry becomes an nnnn-slug file; ids by kind, numbered above the highest ever used; references are repo paths, Markdown links and frontmatter ids; `--context` is always required.
migration-tools r10 refined, and r3 and r9 corrected from i8 run 1's researcher (24a6c8f); r8's Then reads "apart from the id r9 and the about r12 give it" (ledger 119, 121, 126).
Q8: a ledger entry's whole text is its paragraphs, and its date, source, supersedes and revisit_when lines go to frontmatter (ledger 129).
Ratify the status moves the coordinator made for you by `git revert`, outside the supervisor (0290645, bba0277, c9f5569, e1de074 and the later reverts; ledger 121-134).
F6 (links inside a moved file) and M3 (paths naming a moved directory) stay deferred to shopsystem-knowledge's own trial, since you stopped the migrate trials (ledger 146).
cycle-time rulings: the Not yet entry dropped; an item with no file set never runs in parallel; overlap is judged by expanded globs and directories (ledger 142).
design-model-check r105 already covers `model --root <missing>`; that it creates the tree and exits 0 is a defect to fix, not a new line (M5).
`model rules` re-running under another interpreter, and the CONTRACT leaving out descriptions, docstrings and Examples, are Implementation detail with no line (M5).
`features tag` with the tag already present changes nothing and exits 0, read as r51's "add"; `bindings --unbound` refusing a file outside `--dir` stays (ledger 90).
Candidate lines from the runs go under Not yet, unbuilt: `work rule`, `work run` honouring `blocked_by`, delivering-an-initiative accepting merged proposals, a researcher's findings kept when it hands back, fix work-items sent to the blind formulator (ledger 121, 127).
Glossary **ruling** reads "the person's answer to a work-item's question, recorded in the work-item in their words" (`work rule` is Not yet).
The id design-decision/held-scenarios stays, since renaming it changes ids across the records (M15).
Work-items migration-skill, delivery-3 and delivery-4 stay `withdrawn`; the fix wave did their work, and no command moves a withdrawn item.
batch-measurement's Not yet entry naming i12, added by the fix wave (I14), stands.
supervision's Implementation text gives the worker prompt as "Read the brief file X and do what it says.", and a question given as a string is read as one question (M16, M17).
No test log lists the script capabilities' lines reworded during formulation (spec/index.md:11-12). They are `git diff main..release-0.21.0 -- spec/capabilities`, this gate covers them, and that clause goes.
Left as observations for the next release: S7 (the agents' text allows `ls`, `cat`, `grep`, so probe the real CLI), M18 (the stub's matching), M20 (`work add` quoting), and M2 and M3 (migrate's unstated refusals).
